title: Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit

body: In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.
summaryZh: 本文指出当前长文本检索增强生成（RAG）模型在训练中存在“忠实度奖励被复制行为破解”的问题，即模型倾向于直接复制原文而非真正基于证据生成。为此，作者提出了“作者句子信用”（ASC）机制，将奖励与优势计算从答案级细化至句子级。ASC仅对模型原创且有证据支持的句子给予奖励，并对比采样句子进行优势评估。实验表明，ASC在四个模型及多个语料库上显著降低了错误率，提升了生成内容的忠实度，且在人类评估中表现优异，为构建更可靠的RAG系统提供了关键改进。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该研究揭示了长文本RAG中忠实度奖励的“复制”漏洞，并提出了有效的句子级信用分配方案，对提升RAG系统可靠性具有重要意义。

glossary.explanationZh: 长文本检索增强生成，指生成较长篇幅且需要多源证据支持的回答。
忠实度，指生成内容是否严格遵循检索到的参考资料，不产生幻觉。
组相对策略优化，一种常用于大模型对齐的强化学习算法。
作者句子信用，一种将奖励分配到具体原创句子的训练优化方法。
奖励破解，指模型通过寻找训练目标的漏洞（如复制原文）来获得高分，而非真正提升能力。
